input.question: According to the dbt-core repository's schema.yml conventions (as seen in starter project and functional test fixtures), which top-level structure is used to define models with column-level descriptions and built-in tests such as `unique` and `not_null`?

options.A: A `version: 2` document with a `models:` list, where each entry has `name`, `description`, and `columns:` containing `data_tests:`
options.B: A `version: 1` document with a `models:` list, where each entry has `name`, `description`, and `columns:` containing `data_tests:`
options.C: A `version: 2` document with a `data_tests:` list, where each entry has `name`, `description`, and `columns:` containing `unique` and `not_null`
options.D: A `version: 2` document with a `sources:` list, where each entry has `name`, `description`, and `columns:` containing `tests:`
